title: 第24章 教习道歉
novel_title: 御兽仙朝：我能设计进化形态
content_zh:
接下来的课程，金教习讲得很快。

    无非是些觉醒等级、食料配比上的细枝末节。

    可底下那群崽子，已没几个能真正听进去了。

    他们的心思，早就飘到了别处。

    “今日的课，便到这里。”

    金教习袖子一拂。

    “我宣布，下课。”

    学子们三三两两地，起了身。

    可那位一直立在角落里的冯教习，却没有走。

    他立在原地，那道浑浊的目光，久久地停在那最末一排。

    也不知，过了多久。

    “老冯。”

    金教习走到他身边，轻声唤了一句：

    “走吧。”

    冯教习这才回过神来，缓缓地迈开了步子。

    只是，在经过罗影那张课桌时，他的脚步却顿了一下。

    那张布满皱纹的脸，侧了过来。

    浑浊的眼里，似有千言万语，在喉头滚动。

    他张了张嘴。

    可最终，却什么也没说出口。

    只是深深地，看了那少年一眼，便迈步出了学堂。

    而随着这两位教习的身影，彻底消失在了学堂门外。

    整个课堂的气氛，齐刷刷地变了。

    五百道目光，再没了顾忌，齐齐地聚向了两个人。

    一个，是空降了头名的，王健。

    一个，是那只蚁，天赋冠绝全场的罗影。

    头一个按捺不住的，是挨着罗影坐的李子诚。

    “罗影！”

    他一把抓住罗影的胳膊，声音里，满是压不住的惊叹。

    “在蒙学里头，那些个连先生都要皱眉头的兽理变式题，你都能一道一道，给解出来。”

    “我就晓得，你小子，准有一手！”

    “今日……可算是藏不住了吧！”

    他凑过去，把那只趴在桌角、依旧瘸着一条腿的小玄，仔仔细细地又打量了一圈。

    那眼神里头，没有半分旁人那样的惊疑，只有满满的、衷心的欢喜。

    金教习刚才说的话他是全记下来的。

    这只蚁，只是有一个心结而已。

    目前，进化所需要的能量，已经被【砺勇石】给补足了。

    剩下的，就只是解开心结了。

    考核还有整整半年的时间。

    这半年的时间，怎么样，也应该把那个结给解开了吧？

    这意味着什么...

    李子诚很清楚。

    这意味着，罗影已半只脚跨过了那门槛，把晋级考核的名额牢牢地握在了自己的手中。

    对他们这般穷苦人家的孩子来说，这是何等天大的事情？

    李子诚替他这好友感到高兴。

    “是小玄争气。”

    罗影笑了笑，伸手抚摸了一下桌角上的小玄。

    “和我...没有多大的关系。”

    他没有半分居功。

    而在另外一头，刚刚取得头名的王健。竟也主动走了过来。

    他脸上并没什么得了头名的倨傲，反而显得很是爽朗。

    他大大咧咧地给罗影一拱手：

    “罗兄。”

    “今天的这头名，我当的心虚的很。”

    “你那只蚁的天赋，明摆的在我这只之上。
content_en:
Professor Jin taught the next lesson very quickly.

It's nothing more than details about the level of awakening and the ratio of food to food.

But few of the brats down there can really listen.

Their thoughts have long been elsewhere.

"Today's lesson ends here."

Professor Jin flicked his sleeves.

"I declare that get out of class is over."

The students stood up in twos and threes.

But Professor Feng, who had been standing in the corner, did not leave.

He stood there, his turbid gaze resting on the last row for a long time.

I don’t know how long it took.

"Old Feng."

Jin Jiaoxi walked to him and called softly:

"Let's go."

Only then did Professor Feng come back to his senses and slowly took steps forward.

However, when he passed Luo Ying's desk, his steps paused.

The wrinkled face turned sideways.

In his cloudy eyes, there seemed to be thousands of words rolling down his throat.

He opened his mouth.

But in the end, nothing was said.

He just took a deep look at the young man and walked out of the school.

And as the figures of these two teachers completely disappeared outside the school door.

The atmosphere of the entire classroom suddenly changed.

Five hundred eyes, no longer scrupulous, all focused on the two people.

One was Wang Jian, who took the top spot.

One is that ant, Luo Ying, who has the most talent among all.

The first one who couldn't hold himself back was Li Zicheng, who was sitting next to Luo Ying.

"Luo Ying!"

He grabbed Luo Ying's arm, his voice full of uncontrollable exclamation.

"In elementary school, you can solve all the animal physics questions that even the teacher would frown upon, one by one."

"I knew that you, kid, must have a skill!"

"Today... I can't hide it anymore!"

He leaned over and looked around carefully at Xiao Xuan, who was lying on the corner of the table, still lame on one leg.

In those eyes, there was no trace of surprise like others, only full and heartfelt joy.

He had written down everything Jin Jiaoxi had just said.

This ant just has a knot in his heart.

Currently, the energy needed for evolution has been replenished by the [Strengthening Stone].

All that's left is to untie the knot.

There is still half a year left for the assessment.

In the past six months, I think I should have untied that knot, right?

What does this mean...

Li Zicheng knows very well.

This means that Luo Ying has already crossed the threshold with half a foot, and firmly holds the quota for the promotion assessment in his own hands.

How big a deal is this for children from poor families like them?

Li Zicheng was happy for his good friend.

"It's Xiaoxuan who strives for success."

Luo Ying smiled and reached out to touch Xiao Xuan on the corner of the table.

"It...has nothing to do with me."

He doesn't take half of the credit.

At the other end, Wang Jian just won the first place.He also took the initiative to come over.

There was nothing arrogant about winning the first prize on his face, but he looked very cheerful.

He gave Luo Ying a carefree hand:

"Brother Luo."

"I feel very guilty for taking this title today."

"Your ant's talent is clearly superior to mine.
